_comment: maxPerDay must be raised in the SAME commit as the plan that uses it. check.js (run by the render workflow since 2026-09-07) fails a plan whose pin count exceeds maxPerDay. dispatch.js does NOT fail: once the rolling 24h count reaches maxPerDay it stops sending, and the pins left over are dropped as 'late' after lateMinutes with no error anywhere. Planned steps: 9 -> 12 on 2026-09-13, review 15 on 2026-09-20.
